Sandbox_CWModpackCompatibility.NaturesCa: Enabled by default when both mods are active. Disables Lifestyle's bladder progression and relief actions so Nature's Call exclusively handles urination and bowel needs. Lifestyle's cleaning, grooming, bathing integration, and other hobbies remain available.
Sandbox_CWModpackCompatibility.RestoreLi: Restore Lifestyle bathroom needs when unowned

Enabled by default. If Nature's Call ownership is inactive and an older preset left Lifestyle's bladder multiplier at zero, restores Lifestyle's default multiplier of 1. Disable this before intentionally turning off Lifestyle's bathroom need while Nature's Call is absent.
Sandbox_CWModpackCompatibility.BrushYour: Brush Your Damn Teeth owns dental hygiene

Enabled by default when both mods are active. Removes Lifestyle's brushing actions so Brush Your Damn Teeth exclusively controls brushing, item wear, dental hygiene, and dental consequences. Other Lifestyle mirror, cabinet, grooming, and hygiene actions remain available.
Sandbox_CWModpackCompatibility.DisableLi: Enabled by default. Keeps Lifestyle's personal hygiene need neutral and hides its clean/dirty hygiene moodles. Lifestyle cleaning actions and skills remain enabled. PZ Pulse Expanded omits the Lifestyle hygiene bar when its compatible adapter is installed. Restart after changing this option.
Sandbox_CWModpackCompatibility.BanditPla: Player reactions to Bandit NPC hits

Players visibly react when damaged by a Bandit NPC firearm, melee weapon, or bare-hand attack. Disable this if hit reactions interfere with another combat or animation mod. This does not change damage or wounds.
Minimum time between visible reactions. Increase this to reduce repeated interruption from rapid attacks, or use 0 for no cooldown. The default is 750 milliseconds.
Chance that confirmed damage from a Bandit NPC firearm produces a visible player reaction. This does not change firearm accuracy or damage.
Chance that confirmed damage from a Bandit NPC melee weapon or bare-hand attack produces a visible player reaction. This does not change melee damage.
Sandbox_UsefulBarrelsFunnelSpeedUpFillMo:
Speeds up canister filling when a funnel is nearby.
For example, 1.25 means a 25 percent bonus, or 1.25 times faster.
Set to 1 to disable the speed bonus.
Does not work if 'Require Funnel' is disabled.
Sandbox_TAWBaseHallucinationChanceMin_to: The minimum likelihood of a hallucination triggering, expressed as a percentage.
Sandbox_TAWBaseHallucinationChanceMax_to: The maximum likelihood of a hallucination triggering, expressed as a percentage.
Sandbox_BanditsWeekOne.InhabitantsPistol: NPC inhabitants with handguns, percentage chance
Sandbox_BanditsWeekOne.StreetsPistolChan: NPCs on streets with handguns, percentage chance
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.InflationDecay_to: Percentage of price inflation recovered every day. 0.1 means 10 percent decay, 0.5 means 50 percent decay, and 0.0 means inflation never decays.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCMeleeStaminaCo: Base stamina cost for each melee swing at skill level 0. Higher melee skill lowers this cost to about 10 percent at level 20.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCRangedStaminaC: Base stamina cost for each shot at skill level 0. Higher shooting skill lowers this cost to about 10 percent at level 20.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCStaminaThresho: Stamina fraction from 0.05 to 0.95 at which an exhausted NPC resumes normal activity. The default 0.40 means 40 percent.
Sandbox_ExplosivesOptions_FireDamageMult: Multiplies additional fire damage to burning zombies. 0.5 is about 30 percent faster than vanilla, 1.0 is about twice as fast, and 5.0 is about five times faster.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_InitialPerkBonus_tool: Include the initial perk bonus: 75 percent, 100 percent, or 125 percent.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_LevelBonus_tooltip: Extra XP multiplier per perk level. At level 5 with a value of 0.30, the bonus is 150 percent.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonusNegative_t: XP multiplier while the Rested Bonus penalty is active. For example, 0.90 means 10 percent less XP.
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExerciseNegat: XP multiplier while the Space Out Exercise penalty is active. For example, 0.90 means 10 percent less XP.
Sandbox_Plumbing.PumpMaxWater_tooltip: Units of water delivered every game minute by a pump at 100 percent efficiency.
Sandbox_BYDT_DentalFlossHouseUsageMax: Dental floss - house: max usage percent
Sandbox_BYDT_DentalFlossHouseUsageMin: Dental floss - house: min usage percent
Sandbox_BYDT_DentalFlossTrashUsageMax: Dental floss - trash: max usage percent
Sandbox_BYDT_DentalFlossTrashUsageMin: Dental floss - trash: min usage percent
Sandbox_BYDT_OpSkillWeightPercent_toolti: How much of an operation's success is driven by your First Aid skill versus luck. 70 (default) = 70 percent skill, 30 percent random. 100 = pure skill; 0 = pure chance.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_CrowbarProgressD: Progress removed each decay tick. Default 1 percent.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_PinResistanceEna: When on, pins bind after about 50 percent lift. The first pin in the sequence is stiffest. Off by default.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_ReinforcedGreenH: Progress added per green-zone hit on security doors. Default 20 percent.
Sandbox_NeatLockpicking_ReinforcedYellow: Progress added per yellow-zone hit on security doors. Default 10 percent.
Sandbox_PlowAttachment_AllowPrefit_toolt: Vehicles that spawn in the world occasionally come with a Corpse Plow Blade already fitted (2 percent by default, up to 12 percent in work-vehicle zones like McCoy). Turn OFF so every plow has to be crafted and fitted by hand. Only affects vehicles at the moment they spawn -- already-spawned vehicles keep their blade.
